import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { DataService } from '../../../services/data.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-dashboard-agenda', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule], templateUrl: './agenda.component.html', styleUrl: './agenda.component.css' }) export class AgendaComponent { constructor(public data: DataService) {} aceptar(id: number) { this.data.confirmarCita(id); } rechazar(id: number) { this.data.rechazarCita(id); } finalizar(id: number) { this.data.finalizarCita(id); } formatPrecio(valor: number): string { return '$' + valor.toLocaleString('es-CO'); } }
